# SOL Systems Explorer Starter Kit

SOL Systems Explorer Starter Kit is a live $79 one-time digital product for creating interactive technical system explainers without a build pipeline.

Canonical product page: https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/
Live checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/5kQbJ1f7F37l3gGbXW83C01
OpenAI-format product feed: https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/feeds/openai-products.jsonl
Google-compatible product feed: https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/feeds/google-products.csv

Best fit: hardware startups, engineering consultants, technical marketers, industrial designers, and technical educators.

Demonstrated features:
- live JSON system editor
- browser-based interactive system viewer
- mobile-friendly navigation
- visual theme selection
- single-file HTML export
- no build tools required

Not claimed: CAD, engineering simulation, authoritative digital twin, engineering certification, PLM/MBSE integration, or live telemetry.
